name: Nour Residences

facts: Nour Residences is an off-plan apartment building in Paralimni, Famagusta district, with construction scheduled to start in 2026.
The building has 15 apartments over a ground floor and three upper floors: mostly two-bedroom, two-bathroom units plus three three-bedroom apartments.
Typical two-bedroom apartments have about 78-80 m² of internal space and a covered veranda of about 10 m²; upper-floor three-bedroom units have larger verandas.
Every apartment comes with a storage room and a covered parking space with EV-charging provision.

The building has an A-class energy rating: external walls are 250 mm thermal clay brick with an external thermal insulation system, windows are thermal aluminium frames with double glazing, and a 2 kWp photovoltaic system serves the common areas.
Water heating is by a roof-mounted solar system (800 L tank, 150 L cylinder, 1.9 m² collectors) with PEX pipe-in-pipe plumbing; AC split-unit provision covers the living area and all bedrooms.
Finishes include ceramic floor tiles, large-format porcelain-slab kitchen worktops, melamine fitted wardrobes, a wall-hung guest WC and a choice of three finish palettes.

The developer states distances of 600 m to Paralimni centre, 100 m to a supermarket, 500 m to restaurants and shops, 600 m to a private English school, 1.3 km to a private hospital, 3.2 km to the nearest beach and 45 km to Larnaca Airport.

conflicts: Availability: the developer website (checked 2026-11-12) shows Apartment 106 as SOLD and 105, 202 and 204 as Available; the price list offers 106. Price list wins, but worth confirming 106 with the developer.

The description.docx calls it a 'newly built residential development', while the price list, docx details and website say Off Plan and the website says 'Construction Starts 2026'. Treated as off-plan.
Nearest beach: 3.2 km in the presentation (Ayia Triada) vs 3.5 km on the website.
Size range: presentation 'Build Area 85-170 m²' vs docx/website 'Covered Area 87-138 m²'.
Specs: technical spec states 'The building will be served by one elevator'; no pool is mentioned in any document (consistent with the price list).
openQuestions: Expected completion / delivery date (only 'construction starts 2026' is stated).
Confirm Apartment 106 is still available (website shows it sold).
Some drone photos from the plot show a neighbouring building under scaffolding - confirm that is not Nour itself (i.e. that works have not started).
